solutionSql:
SELECT c.id,
       c.name
FROM customers c
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM shipments s
  JOIN invoices i ON i.shipment_id = s.id
  WHERE s.customer_id = c.id
)
ORDER BY c.id;
notes: All six customers with shipments have an invoiced shipment, and customers 7 and 8 have no shipments at all. EXISTS over the join returns each customer once, with no duplicates.
